The '''2006 Liga de Fútbol Profesional Boliviano''' or '''2006 Segundo Torneo''' was a professional football tournament in Bolivia that was played to revert the adjustment to the European calendar caused by the [[2005 Liga de Fútbol Profesional Boliviano|2005 Torneo Adecuación]].
